_comment: Committable Claude Code settings. UserPromptSubmit + PreToolUse run the launch-path-independent session-registration guard (ensure-session-registered.sh): seeds agency_session_registry for job/bridge/headless-p launches where the SessionStart hook (and preflight §10) never run. Marker-guarded, fail-open. Task 80de6ffa / The Engine Room. Stop hook added 2026-09-06 (CORTEX): classify-if-ready.sh only ran on UserPromptSubmit, which fires BEFORE the turn is on disk, so it depended on a NEXT prompt to classify the previous one. A single-turn headless session has no next prompt, so it was never classified at all — 579 of the 655 unexamined transcripts on the Mac are that exact shape. Stop fires once the transcript is complete.
